    AI Overview
    Earth Day is observed annually on April 22. It marks the anniversary of the birth of the modern environmental movement in 1970 and is a global event dedicated to environmental protection, with 2026 marking another year of action on this date. 
    Key details about Earth Day: 
    • Purpose: To raise awareness about environmental issues and encourage action for a healthier planet.
    • Annual Date: April 22.
    • Origin: First held on April 22, 1970, when millions of Americans rallied for environmental reform.
    • Activities: Events include local clean-ups, educational workshops, tree planting, and sustainability initiatives. 
    Many organizations and communities host special "Party for the Planet" events or clean-up activities around this date.

    People also ask
    What are the biggest threats to Earth?
    An AI Overview is not available for this searchCan't generate an AI overview right now. Try again later.
    AI Overview
    The greatest threats to Earth include immediate, human-driven climate change, biodiversity loss, and habitat destruction, alongside catastrophic risks from outer space like asteroid impacts. Environmental risks such as extreme weather, pollution, and ecosystem collapse are considered the most urgent, according to the WWF Global Risk Report. 
    Top Environmental & Human-Caused Threats 
    • Climate Change: Rising temperatures cause sea-level rise, droughts, wildfires, and reduced agricultural yields.
    • Biodiversity Loss: Intensive agriculture, poaching, and habitat destruction place 1 million species at risk.
    • Pollution & Resource Depletion
      :
      Overexploitation of natural resources and pollution (e.g., plastics, toxins) are degrading ecosystem services.
    • Nuclear War: An immense threat to the biosphere.
    • AI & Technological Risks: Potential, albeit speculative, risks from Artificial Intelligence. 
    Top Space-Based Threats 
    • Asteroid Impacts: Large, unpredictable space rocks colliding with Earth could cause massive destruction.
    • Coronal Mass Ejections: Violent solar bursts could paralyze global electrical grids.
    • Gamma-ray Bursts: High-energy radiation from supernovas could strip the atmosphere. 
    Key Perspectives 
    • Anthropogenic Focus: Many experts argue that human inaction and consumption are the most immediate threats to the planet.
    • Long-term Future: Over a longer timescale, the Sun's evolution into a red giant is the ultimate threat to Earth. 
    For a detailed understanding of the most imminent risks, check the findings of the WWF Global Risk Report.

      Is April 22 always Earth Day?
      Earth Day is celebrated on April 22 in the United States and on either April 22 or the day the spring equinox occurs throughout the rest of the world. Environmental activism during the 1960s inspired Wisconsin Sen. Gaylord Nelson to create a national celebration uniting the environmental movement.
